specific_observations: Fixture::holdout_bytes reads a new handle while the original LockedFileFinalHoldoutCasStore remains held in the runner. The original store takes file.try_lock; OS33 is observed.
Original evaluator tests read original-evaluator by path while the signer still owns LearningOwnerJournal. These ExecutionOwner tests are distinct from the newly added Linux-only ReceiptOwner.
feature journal/control and generation service cases also contain reads by path while original or reopened owners are alive.
The evaluation support change from be8 extracts journal_with_manifest; the holdout owner/read pattern already exists in be8 source. This is source comparison, not a baseline execution claim.
Some circuit cases report only Invalid or PermissionDenied through generic fixture wrappers; a deeper cause was not established by these logs.
The perception comparison differs by one trailing byte 13; the test removes only the fixture's final byte.
The TUI failure compares an ordinary Windows path with a canonical path containing the extended-length prefix.

sandbox_policy_and_core_integration.finding: Original Windows sandbox refusal remains: ambient parent FILE_DELETE_CHILD can bypass deletion boundaries. Additional core integration failures remain observations on this source; no policy relaxation was attempted.
